description: Department of Government Information - Validity of the Media Accreditation Issued for the Year 2020 by the Department of Government Information has been Extended Until further Notice
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the extension of media accreditations issued by the Department of Government Information. This is an administrative matter related to the public service and the conditions under which it operates, specifically falling under public sector administration and instructions. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or any of the other specialized categories like Land, Legal, Commercial, Elections, or Judicial matters.
